titulo: O(n²) versus O(n log n): bubble and merge sort
enunciado: Generate reproducible pseudo-random data of size 8, 16, 32 and 64 and count the comparisons of bubble sort and merge sort on identical copies. Show the table and the bubble/merge ratio.
objetivos: Watch how the gap grows as n increases
pistas: Sort two copies of the same array so the comparison is fair.
Plain bubble sort always makes n(n-1)/2 comparisons.
Merge sort makes at most n log2(n) comparisons.
